title: La Paz y El Alto: Cholitas, cholets y modernidad aymara
goal: Explore the metropolitan contrast between La Paz and El Alto, urban cable cars, neo-Andean cholets, and proud cholitas.
grammar: urbanismo andino, red de teleféricos, arquitectura cholet y empoderamiento de la mujer de pollera

items: Analyze the geographic and social articulation between La Paz and El Alto via Mi Teleférico.
Explore Freddy Mamani's neo-Andean cholets and their Tiwanaku geometric inspiration.
Deploy urban architecture, indigenous pride, and cultural identity vocabulary (cholet, cholita, pollera, teleférico).
